hooks.command: jq -e '.tool_input.file_path | type == "string" and test("(^|/)\\.env$")' > /dev/null && jq -n '{"continue":false,"stopReason":".env files contain secrets — edit them outside the agent"}' && exit 2 || exit 0

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; [ -n "$f" ] && case "$f" in *.go) command -v gofmt >/dev/null && gofmt -w "$f";; *.py) command -v ruff >/dev/null && ruff format -q "$f";; *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.json|*.css) command -v npx >/dev/null && npx --no-install prettier -w "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
